events.title: AI data centers in space: Millions of satellites and so many unknowns

events.title: Germany news: Job market unlikely to recover before summer

events.title: Canada: Supreme Court largely upholds Quebec secularism bill

events.title: France seeks German man in Channel migrant boat probe

events.description: A major addition to Europe's cultural scene: Kanal-Centre Pompidou, the new contemporary art museum in a former Citroen factory complex, is celebrating its opening with a free, nonstop weekend program.

events.title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong
events.description: The tiny Vallarta mud turtle was only discovered in 2018. It's critically endangered with around 300 thought to live in the wild. Almost one tenth of that number were stashed in a traveler's luggage, bound in duct tape.
